text: My sourdough starter needs feeding every twelve hours in warm weather. I keep it at a hydration of one hundred percent, equal parts flour and water by weight, and it doubles in about four hours once active.

The rear derailleur on my bicycle kept skipping gears until I adjusted the barrel tensioner a quarter turn counterclockwise. The chain also needed a link removed after I swapped to a shorter cassette.
My passport renewal appointment is booked for the third week of November at the regional passport office. I need to bring two photographs, the old passport, and a filled Form 2C.
The fiddle-leaf fig by the window drops leaves if it gets moved or overwatered. I water it only when the top two inches of soil are dry, roughly once every ten days.
A colleague recommended a book called Klara and the Sun, a novel about an artificial friend who observes human grief and hope from the outside. I added the book to my reading list for next month.
The guest wifi network at the apartment is named Harborlight-Guest and the password is stored in the router's admin panel under the wireless settings tab, not on the sticker on the router itself.
